absent: Numeric values, bit positions, widths, and full enumeration of control, clean, intercept, exit code, and event info fields.
Complete layouts, sizes, alignment, and ownership of virtual CPU, control structure, save area, and per CPU data objects.

Behavior, contracts, and side effects of helpers not routed here such as nested virtualization, local interrupt controller access, address space management, speculation control, debug control, performance monitoring gates, and halt handling.
Locking, sleeping, preemption, and concurrency rules beyond interrupt flag and global mask bracketing shown here.
Failure modes for hardware run faults, reboot interplay details, and userspace exit handling beyond the failure entry report.

findings.text: Main SVM run entry accepts a virtual CPU plus run control flags and yields a fast path disposition after one guest attempt. It stages guest register state into the control structure, honors forced immediate exit requests, reports hardware entry vetoes through the user exit area, synchronizes interrupt priority and address space controls, applies nested and enlightenment fixups, brackets the transition with interrupt masking and speculation handling, reloads guest visible state on return, finalizes translation and performance tracking, completes any vectored event, and delegates to fast path exit handling.

Low level enter exit wrapper marks guest context for tracers and resource tracking, enables processor interrupt flag while global interrupts remain masked, clears divider state, dispatches to separate standard or encrypted state guest execution helpers, then disables the interrupt flag and marks return to host context.

Assembly world switch preserves host callee state, restores guest speculation controls, loads host save area and current control structure addresses, brings guest general registers into place, clears CPU buffers, executes the hardware run instruction, then on exit saves guest registers, restores host save area, refills return prediction resources, restores host speculation controls, mitigates return misprediction, scrubs guest values from registers, and provides fault continuations that loop while reboot is signalled and otherwise fault.

Encrypted state variant preserves a smaller host register set in a dedicated save area together with incoming arguments, restores guest speculation controls, fetches the current control structure address, clears buffers, performs the hardware run, then refills return prediction resources, restores host speculation controls, mitigates return misprediction, and provides a fault continuation for reboot versus fault.

Exit event completion resets one shot injection markers, detects forward progress past a tracked return address to unmask nonmaskable delivery and request event work, clears queued exception and interrupt state, exits early when no valid vectored event is reported, otherwise requests event work and demultiplexes the event type into nonmaskable marking, exception requeue with optional error code except for a never reinjected vector, maskable requeue, and soft requeue paths, with soft event rewinding applied when a soft injection had been attempted.

Soft event rewind distinguishes firmware support for automatic next instruction tracking from legacy manual advancement. With support it restores a saved next address when the current linear address still matches the recorded prior address, for soft types and soft like vectors. Without support it restores a saved prior address when the current linear address still matches the recorded next address. A pending nested run causes a refresh of soft state before evaluation.

Task priority synchronization between local interrupt controller state and control structure interrupt control is skipped under nested priority virtualization. One direction copies the masked priority from the control structure into controller state only when writes are not intercepted. The opposite direction always writes masked controller priority back into the control structure field.

Exception requeue asserts that no exception is already pending, requests event processing, then marks the architectural exception slot as injected with supplied vector and error code presence, and clears any payload association.
Injection cancellation moves pending injection payload and error information into the exit information area, clears the pending injection field, then runs normal exit event completion.

Fast path exit selection requires firmware next address support plus a nonzero saved next address and rejects nested guest execution. It then dispatches a model specific register path conditioned on an exit detail flag, halt handling, and cache invalidate handling, returning a neutral disposition for all other exits.

Fast halt and invalidate paths first check a performance monitoring permission gate and decline when disallowed. Halt emulation failure diverts to userspace, success with a still running virtual CPU reenters, otherwise reports handled. Invalidate emulation failure diverts to userspace, success reenters.
Invalidate emulation is defined as a no operation that simply advances past the emulated instruction and reports success.

Guest entry and exit mark a quiescent interval for reclamation tracking, preferring context tracking notification and falling back to an explicit context switch note. Entry orders instrumentation start, tracer and lock dependency preparation, instrumentation end, context entry, and lock dependency activation. Exit orders lock dependency deactivation, context exit, then instrumented tracer completion.
Clean tracking for the control structure is expressed as all clean coverage with always dirty coverage removed.

Hypervisor enlightenment handling has two build variants. One compares the stored virtual processor identifier against the current index and updates plus marks nested enlightenments dirty on difference. The other performs no action.
Global interrupt flag manipulation uses fault guarded privileged operations that divert to a spurious fault routine on fault rather than propagating an exception.

Control and save areas expose interrupt control and priority, event injection and exit event information with error codes, next address, exit code, address space identifier and translation control, nested enlightenment identifier, debug and performance controls, and saved general plus control registers and fault address.

The run path executes the hardware transition with host interrupt flag set while global masking keeps physical delivery blocked, bracketed by explicit global mask clear before entry and set after exit, with nonmaskable exit handling bracketed around the post exit window.
Vectored event reporting distinguishes valid indication, error code validity, vector selection, and separate encodings for nonmaskable, exception, maskable, and soft delivery.
Reusable host services provide exception requeue, invalidate and halt fast paths, invalidate emulation, and no operation emulation for other virtualization paths.
Low level run helpers provide callable transitions for standard and encrypted state guests.
